technical_summary: Requested architecture: private VPC deploy in eu-west-1 (primary) with optional fallback in us-east-1. Inference fleet in private subnets behind NATs; no public ingress. Control-plane connectivity via AWS PrivateLink or VPC peering to Redwood control plane endpoints. Use interface endpoints for S3 and KMS; egress only to approved endpoints. BYOK: customer-managed CMKs in their AWS account; Redwood to support encrypted model artifacts and runtime decryption via cross-account KMS grants. Audit logging: stream request/response metadata to customer's Kinesis/Splunk endpoint; store masked PII separately with retention controls. Network requirements: provide static egress IPs for firewall allowlisting; support VPC route tables and security group templates. Expected POC throughput: 10 qps steady, 50 qps burst; evaluate autoscaling and batching config in POC.
